name: Aurora
mechanism: Noise-shaped luminous aurora height field and blended colour stops; amplitude, blend, speed.
adaptation: Layered undulating light curtains and tapering vertical rays, computed directly from frames.

name: SoftAurora
mechanism: Layered low-frequency noise aurora bands with bandHeight, bandSpread, octaveDecay and colour drift.
adaptation: Broad overlapping blurred light bands with slowly changing path geometry, distinct from the sharp aurora curtain.

name: Silk
mechanism: Animated trigonometric satin shading, rotation, scale and fine-grain intensity.
adaptation: Curved fold ribbons with moving satin highlight gradients and independently changing edges.

name: Iridescence
mechanism: Iterated sinusoidal interference field with time-varying colour and amplitude.
adaptation: Warped concentric interference lobes with thin alternating spectral contour lines.

name: Orb
mechanism: Noisy luminous spherical rim with hue, hover intensity and rotational deformation.
adaptation: Hollow energy orb composed of irregular breathing ring contours and orbital light filaments.

name: Galaxy
mechanism: Layered procedural stars with depth, rotation, flares, twinkle and density.
adaptation: Seeded expanding star layers with slowly rotated depth positions and cross-shaped star flares.

name: Particles
mechanism: Three-dimensional particle point cloud with spread, projection, random sizes and rotation.
adaptation: Projected drifting round particles with depth-scaled size and deterministic parallax.

name: Beams
mechanism: Stacked tall plane meshes deformed by procedural noise and lit by a directional source.
adaptation: Parallel sculpted light ribbons with independently displaced edges and shaded cross-sections.

name: LightRays
mechanism: Directional source-to-pixel ray strength, spreading, distance fade and angular distortion.
adaptation: Fan-shaped light shafts from one off-canvas emitter with continuously moving tips and split cores.

name: PixelSnow
mechanism: Depth-layered directional falling flakes rendered at a quantized pixel resolution.
adaptation: Seeded square and cross flakes fall diagonally on a pixel lattice at depth-dependent speed.

name: Dither
mechanism: Procedural waves quantized through an ordered colour-and-pixel dithering postprocess.
adaptation: Original wave field selects actual tiny ordered-matrix square marks rather than only changing opacity.

name: RippleGrid
mechanism: A regular grid is radially displaced by sinusoidal ripples with fade and glow.
adaptation: A projected mesh plane lifts in radial wavefronts, with two coordinate families sharing displaced vertices.

name: DotGrid
mechanism: Regular dot positions react to proximity and shock forces, then return toward their anchors.
adaptation: Analytic moving attractor and shock envelope displace and scale a seeded regular dot lattice.

name: Threads
mechanism: Many horizontal noise-shaped strands vary amplitude and spacing across the screen.
adaptation: Two interwoven families of fine horizontal filaments converge and separate around a moving pinch.

name: LiquidChrome
mechanism: Iterative trigonometric coordinate distortion produces sharp reflective liquid bands.
adaptation: Continuous molten reflective contours fill the stage; no user imagery is distorted.

name: Prism
mechanism: A rotating pyramid distance field is ray-marched with glow and multicolour accumulation.
adaptation: Projected rotating triangular pyramid faces and luminous facet edges, generated with deterministic 3D math.

name: DarkVeil
mechanism: A coordinate-network colour field is warped over time with optional scanlines and noise.
adaptation: Original dim flowing veil silhouettes and restrained scanlines, without copying the upstream network weights.

name: GradientBlinds
mechanism: Repeated gradient strips respond to a moving spotlight with mirror, distortion and shine controls.
adaptation: Vertical folding gradient slats carry a travelling curved highlight and continuously move their edges.

name: Plasma
mechanism: Ray-marched deformed volumetric tubes twist through space with emissive energy accumulation.
adaptation: Projected twisting energy tube made of depth-ordered glowing ring cross-sections.

name: ColorBends
mechanism: Iterative coordinate warping bends multicolour bands with controllable frequency, width and rotation.
adaptation: Broad intertwined colour ribbons curve through the stage using independent continuously changing geometry.
